fix_subject: Support non-flat child vectors in list_select, list_where and the array_distance family of functions
pr_title: Merge #26599: Support non-flat child vectors in list_select, list_where and the array_distance family of functions

labels.summary: list_select and list_where raised an internal error when the child vector of a list argument was non-flat (for example a constant NULL child produced by TRY_CAST), because the code accessed it as a flat vector; the fix flattens a reference to the child before use.
